versions.changelog:
Initial release of alibabacloud-domain skill.

- Enables management of Alibaba Cloud domains, ICP filing, and Wan Xiao Zhi websites via DomainCLI.
- Incorporates strict safety gates for runtime validation, private data protection, and write confirmation.
- Supports end-to-end workflows: domain registration, governance, ICP filing, DNS configuration, and AI website deployment.
- Provides clear, stepwise orchestration; stops and awaits user confirmation at payment, identity, or sensitive actions.
- Enforces minimal output by default, with optional file/artifact generation only on explicit user request.
